palette_roles.example: Background panels, main title blocks, major graphic areas

palette_roles.important: Not a rigid percentage; adapt to footage and brand.

palette_roles.example: Subheadings, chart series, secondary panels, labels
palette_roles.accessibility: Check contrast with both primary and neutral
palette_roles.important: Keep meaning consistent across the video.

palette_roles.example: Caption backing, negative space, cards, backgrounds
palette_roles.accessibility: Prefer high contrast for small text
palette_roles.important: Often off-white, cream, grey or pale neutral.
